catalog.query_utf8:
WITH catalog_path AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pg_catalog.set_config('search_path','pg_catalog',true)
), ns AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.oid,n.nspname FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN catalog_path
 WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND left(n.nspname,3)<>'pg_'
), definitions AS (
 SELECT json_build_array('relation',n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind)::text AS definition
 FROM pg_class c JOIN ns n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('column',n.nspname,c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,
   format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,
   pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid))::text
 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN ns n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
 WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('constraint',n.nspname,c.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true))::text
 FROM pg_constraint c JOIN ns n ON n.oid=c.connamespace
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('index',n.nspname,c.relname,pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid))::text
 FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN ns n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('function',n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))::text
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN ns n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE p.prokind IN ('f','p')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('trigger',n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,
   pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true))::text
 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN ns n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal
 UNION ALL
 -- RI trigger names embed installation OIDs, which change on pg_dump/restore.
 -- Hash their stable constraint/function/trigger properties instead.
 SELECT json_build_array('internal-trigger',n.nspname,c.relname,k.conname,
   pn.nspname,p.proname,t.tgtype,t.tgenabled,t.tgdeferrable,t.tginitdeferred,
   t.tgattr::text,encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid))::text
 FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN ns n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace
 LEFT JOIN pg_constraint k ON k.oid=t.tgconstraint WHERE t.tgisinternal
) SELECT definition FROM definitions ORDER BY definition COLLATE "C"

-- Apply after identity.sql and ledger.sql in the offline installer transaction.
-- These are payment authority/evidence records, never another balance ledger.
CREATE SCHEMA core_payments;
CREATE TABLE core_payments.intents (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    created_by_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (channel_id > 0),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider = 'stripe'),
    merchant TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(merchant) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (environment IN ('test','live')),
    currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'USD'),
    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
    credit_units BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (credit_units > 0),
    credits_per_minor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (credits_per_minor = 5000),
    prepare_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(prepare_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 128),
    prepare_hash BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(prepare_hash)=32),
    intent_wire BYTEA,
    credit_journal_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_billing.ledger_journals(id),
    provider_transaction TEXT,
    refund_fenced BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    refunded_minor BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (refunded_minor >= 0 AND refunded_minor <= amount_minor),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    UNIQUE (created_by_user_id,prepare_key),
    UNIQUE (channel_id,provider_transaction),
    CHECK ((credit_journal_id IS NULL) OR provider_transaction IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (credit_units::numeric = amount_minor::numeric * credits_per_minor::numeric)
);

CREATE TABLE core_payments.receipts (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id ~ '^pay_[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    operation_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(operation_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 128),
    method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('prepare','credit','hold','dispatch','commit','release','external_refund')),
    request_hash BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_hash)=32),
    receipt_wire BYTEA NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    UNIQUE (intent_id,operation_key)
);
CREATE TABLE core_payments.refund_holds (
    receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core_payments.receipts(id),
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
    credit_units BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (credit_units > 0),
    reservation_journal_id BIGINT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES core_billing.ledger_journals(id),
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'held' CHECK (state IN ('held','committed','released')),
    provider_refund_id TEXT,
    UNIQUE (intent_id,provider_refund_id)
);
CREATE TABLE core_payments.provider_events (
    channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(event_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    payload_hash BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(payload_hash)=32),
    receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.receipts(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    PRIMARY KEY (channel_id,event_id)
);
-- Distinct Stripe events for one refund cannot apply the refund twice.
CREATE TABLE core_payments.provider_refunds (
    channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    refund_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(refund_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
    receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.receipts(id),
    PRIMARY KEY (channel_id,refund_id)
);
-- A provider refund is a financial fact even when the current nonnegative
-- ledger cannot represent the resulting debt. Retain its independently verified
-- original evidence and fence stale credit. No success receipt is manufactured.
-- Resolution requires the separately implemented debt/reconciliation policy.
CREATE TABLE core_payments.blocked_refunds (
    channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    refund_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_minor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount_minor > 0),
    payload_hash BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(payload_hash)=32),
    signed_payload BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(signed_payload) BETWEEN 1 AND 32768),
    signature BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(signature) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    PRIMARY KEY (channel_id,refund_id),
    UNIQUE (channel_id,event_id)
);

-- Independent webhook ingress is committed before an extension may ACK. These
-- rows certify authentic input only; application receipts/ledger remain separate.
-- Proofs remain valid after queue delays and endpoint-secret rotation because
-- settlement reuses Rust's immutable verified facts, not a caller's timestamp.
CREATE TABLE core_payments.accepted_proofs (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id ~ '^proof_[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
    channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(event_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    payload_hash BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(payload_hash)=32),
    signed_payload BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(signed_payload) BETWEEN 1 AND 32768),
    signature BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(signature) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
    verified_facts JSONB NOT NULL,
    receipt_wire BYTEA NOT NULL,
    accepted_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT statement_timestamp(),
    UNIQUE (channel_id,event_id)
);
CREATE TRIGGER proofs_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.accepted_proofs
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();

CREATE FUNCTION core_payments.protect_intent() RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (NEW.id,NEW.account_id,NEW.created_by_user_id,NEW.channel_id,
        NEW.provider,NEW.merchant,NEW.environment,NEW.currency,NEW.amount_minor,
        NEW.credit_units,NEW.credits_per_minor,NEW.prepare_key,NEW.prepare_hash,NEW.created_at)
        IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.id,OLD.account_id,OLD.created_by_user_id,OLD.channel_id,
        OLD.provider,OLD.merchant,OLD.environment,OLD.currency,OLD.amount_minor,
        OLD.credit_units,OLD.credits_per_minor,OLD.prepare_key,OLD.prepare_hash,OLD.created_at)
        OR (OLD.intent_wire IS NOT NULL AND NEW.intent_wire IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.intent_wire)
        OR (OLD.credit_journal_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.credit_journal_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.credit_journal_id)
        OR (OLD.provider_transaction IS NOT NULL AND NEW.provider_transaction IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.provider_transaction)
        OR (OLD.refund_fenced AND NOT NEW.refund_fenced)
        OR NEW.refunded_minor<OLD.refunded_minor THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable payment identity or decreasing refund fence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER protect_intent BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.intents
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_payments.protect_intent();
CREATE TRIGGER receipts_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.receipts
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER events_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.provider_events
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.provider_refunds
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER blocked_refunds_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.blocked_refunds
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
-- Append to payments.sql after accepted_proofs, before revokes.
CREATE TABLE core_payments.refund_dispatches (
    hold_receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core_payments.refund_holds(receipt_id),
    intent_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.intents(id),
    operation_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(operation_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 128),
    receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES core_payments.receipts(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);
CREATE TABLE core_payments.refund_dispatch_bindings (
    hold_receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core_payments.refund_dispatches(hold_receipt_id),
    channel_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    refund_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(refund_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    proof_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_payments.accepted_proofs(id),
    UNIQUE (channel_id,refund_id)
);
CREATE TRIGGER dispatches_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.refund_dispatches
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER dispatch_bindings_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_payments.refund_dispatch_bindings
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();

REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA core_payments FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA core_payments FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA core_payments FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION core_payments.protect_intent() FROM PUBLIC;

components.sql:
-- Fresh installation only. Install after identity.sql in the final installer.
-- No wallet, balance, migration, Go write path, or automatic production install.
CREATE SCHEMA core_charging;

-- Half-open UTC windows. Calendar weeks start on Monday. Anniversary months
-- always derive from the original anchor (Jan 31 -> Feb 28 -> Mar 31).
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.period_window(p_period TEXT, p_anchor BIGINT,
    p_seconds BIGINT, p_at BIGINT) RETURNS TABLE(start_at BIGINT, end_at BIGINT)
LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE STRICT SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
DECLARE t TIMESTAMP; a TIMESTAMP; s TIMESTAMP; e TIMESTAMP; n INTEGER;
BEGIN
    t := to_timestamp(p_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
    CASE p_period
    WHEN 'day' THEN s := date_trunc('day', t); e := s + interval '1 day';
    WHEN 'week' THEN s := date_trunc('week', t); e := s + interval '1 week';
    WHEN 'month' THEN s := date_trunc('month', t); e := s + interval '1 month';
    WHEN 'lifetime' THEN
        start_at := -62135596800; end_at := 253402300800;
        RETURN NEXT; RETURN;
    WHEN 'anniversary_month' THEN
        a := to_timestamp(p_anchor) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
        n := (extract(year FROM t)::integer - extract(year FROM a)::integer) * 12
            + extract(month FROM t)::integer - extract(month FROM a)::integer;
        s := a + make_interval(months => n);
        IF s > t THEN n := n - 1; s := a + make_interval(months => n); END IF;
        e := a + make_interval(months => n + 1);
    WHEN 'custom' THEN
        IF p_seconds <= 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid period' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END IF;
        start_at := (p_anchor::numeric
            + floor((p_at::numeric - p_anchor) / p_seconds) * p_seconds)::bigint;
        end_at := start_at + p_seconds;
        RETURN NEXT; RETURN;
    ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid period' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END CASE;
    start_at := extract(epoch FROM s AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::bigint;
    end_at := extract(epoch FROM e AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::bigint;
    RETURN NEXT;
END $$;

CREATE TABLE core_charging.budgets (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('account', 'member', 'self', 'key')),
    account_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    user_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    key_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
    issuer_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    period TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'custom', 'lifetime')),
    -- Calendar imports with another source timezone must be rejected, not moved
    -- to a different reset boundary. Non-UTC calendar support is not implemented.
    timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC' CHECK (timezone = 'UTC'),
    anchor BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (anchor BETWEEN -62135596800 AND 253402300799),
    seconds BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    limit_credits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (limit_credits >= 0 OR (scope = 'key' AND period = 'lifetime')),
    unlimited BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    -- Legacy keys retain signed displayed remaining quota even while unlimited.
    -- Their display basis is independent of the disabled admission cap.
    display_limit_credits BIGINT,
    revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
    CHECK ((period = 'custom' AND seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 315576000)
        OR (period <> 'custom' AND anchor = 0 AND seconds = 0)),
    CHECK (period <> 'lifetime' OR scope = 'key'),
    CHECK ((scope = 'account' AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND key_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'member' AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND key_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'self' AND account_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND key_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'key' AND account_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND key_id IS NOT NULL)),
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (scope, account_id, user_id, key_id, issuer_user_id, period, anchor, seconds)
);
-- Issuer is part of the identity: an admin's self-limit cannot overwrite a
-- founder's member limit. Every matching rule must pass, across every API key.
CREATE TABLE core_charging.subscriptions (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    grant_reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(grant_reference) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    period TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'custom', 'anniversary_month', 'grant')),
    timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC' CHECK (timezone = 'UTC'),
    anchor BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (anchor BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799),
    seconds BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ends_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (ends_at <= 253402300799 AND ends_at > anchor),
    limit_credits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (limit_credits >= 0),
    unlimited BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    -- A historical current period can have a different basis from later resets.
    -- Renewal after ends_at is a separate grant, never an implicit credit here.
    reset_basis TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'same' CHECK (reset_basis IN ('same', 'explicit')),
    reset_limit_credits BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (reset_limit_credits >= 0),
    reset_unlimited BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    models TEXT[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(models) > 0),
    groups TEXT[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(groups) > 0),
    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    CHECK (reset_basis = 'explicit' OR (reset_limit_credits = 0 AND NOT reset_unlimited)),
    CHECK (period <> 'grant' OR reset_basis = 'same'),
    CHECK ((period = 'custom' AND seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 315576000)
        OR (period <> 'custom' AND seconds = 0))
);
CREATE INDEX subscriptions_account ON core_charging.subscriptions(account_id, id);

-- Opening consumption is an imported historical fact, not a fabricated model
-- request or a mutable balance. Stable scope identity deliberately excludes
-- issuer, budget id/revision, key digest, and membership version.
CREATE TABLE core_charging.budget_opening_consumption (
    scope TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('account', 'member', 'self', 'key')),
    account_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    user_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    key_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
    period TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'custom', 'lifetime')),
    anchor BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (anchor BETWEEN -62135596800 AND 253402300799),
    seconds BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    timezone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UTC' CHECK (timezone = 'UTC'),
    start_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (start_at BETWEEN -62135596800 AND 253402300799),
    end_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (end_at > start_at AND end_at <= 253402300800),
    consumed_credits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (consumed_credits >= 0),
    import_reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(import_reference) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    CHECK ((period = 'custom' AND seconds BETWEEN 1 AND 315576000)
        OR (period <> 'custom' AND anchor = 0 AND seconds = 0)),
    CHECK (period <> 'lifetime' OR scope = 'key'),
    CHECK ((scope = 'account' AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND key_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'member' AND account_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND key_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'self' AND account_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND key_id IS NULL)
        OR (scope = 'key' AND account_id IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL AND key_id IS NOT NULL)),
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (scope, account_id, user_id, key_id, period, anchor, seconds, start_at)
);
CREATE TABLE core_charging.subscription_opening_consumption (
    subscription_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core_charging.subscriptions(id),
    start_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (start_at BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799),
    end_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (end_at > start_at AND end_at <= 253402300799),
    consumed_credits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (consumed_credits >= 0),
    import_reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(import_reference) BETWEEN 1 AND 200)
);

CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_opening_consumption() RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
DECLARE w RECORD; s core_charging.subscriptions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'budget_opening_consumption' THEN
        SELECT * INTO w FROM core_charging.period_window(NEW.period,NEW.anchor,NEW.seconds,NEW.start_at);
        IF w.start_at <> NEW.start_at OR w.end_at <> NEW.end_at THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'opening budget window mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
    ELSE
        SELECT * INTO STRICT s FROM core_charging.subscriptions WHERE id=NEW.subscription_id FOR SHARE;
        IF NEW.start_at < s.anchor OR NEW.end_at > s.ends_at THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'opening subscription window outside grant' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END IF;
        -- Preserve the exact first next_reset. A calendar/anniversary reset must
        -- still be a boundary of that policy, unless clipped by grant expiry.
        IF s.period = 'grant' THEN
            IF NEW.start_at <> s.anchor OR NEW.end_at <> s.ends_at THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'non-resetting opening must cover the whole grant' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        ELSIF s.period <> 'custom' AND NEW.end_at <> s.ends_at THEN
            SELECT * INTO w FROM core_charging.period_window(s.period,s.anchor,s.seconds,NEW.end_at);
            IF w.start_at <> NEW.end_at THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'opening subscription reset mismatch' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
            END IF;
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER budget_opening_window BEFORE INSERT ON core_charging.budget_opening_consumption
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_opening_consumption();
CREATE TRIGGER subscription_opening_window BEFORE INSERT ON core_charging.subscription_opening_consumption
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_opening_consumption();

CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.subscription_window(p_id BIGINT,p_at BIGINT)
RETURNS TABLE(start_at BIGINT,end_at BIGINT,limit_credits BIGINT,unlimited BOOLEAN)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE STRICT SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
    SELECT CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at < o.end_at THEN o.start_at ELSE w.start_at END,
           least(CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at < o.end_at THEN o.end_at ELSE w.end_at END,s.ends_at),
           CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= o.end_at AND s.reset_basis='explicit'
                THEN s.reset_limit_credits ELSE s.limit_credits END,
           CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= o.end_at AND s.reset_basis='explicit'
                THEN s.reset_unlimited ELSE s.unlimited END
    FROM core_charging.subscriptions s
    LEFT JOIN core_charging.subscription_opening_consumption o ON o.subscription_id=s.id
    -- A never-reset grant has one window for its entire lifetime, even when
    -- longer than the maximum duration allowed for a repeating custom period.
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL core_charging.period_window(
        CASE WHEN s.period='grant' THEN 'custom' ELSE s.period END,
        CASE WHEN s.period='custom' AND o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= o.end_at
             THEN o.end_at ELSE s.anchor END,
        CASE WHEN s.period='grant' THEN s.ends_at-s.anchor ELSE s.seconds END,p_at) w
    WHERE s.id=p_id AND p_at>=s.anchor AND p_at<s.ends_at
      AND (o.subscription_id IS NULL OR p_at>=o.start_at)
      AND (s.reset_basis='same' OR o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL)
$$;

CREATE TABLE core_charging.requests (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    key_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
    assistant_grant_id TEXT,
    image_operation_id TEXT UNIQUE CHECK (image_operation_id IS NULL OR image_operation_id ~ '^image:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    assistant_sponsor_account_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    oauth_source JSONB CHECK (oauth_source IS NULL OR ((jsonb_typeof(oauth_source)='object'
        AND oauth_source ?& ARRAY['grant_id','access_id','client_id','issuer','resource','user_id','personal_account_id','user_version','consent_version','scopes','expires_at','budget_credits']
        AND oauth_source - ARRAY['grant_id','access_id','client_id','issuer','resource','user_id','personal_account_id','user_version','consent_version','scopes','expires_at','budget_credits']='{}'::jsonb
        AND oauth_source->>'client_id'='lmm-pi'
        AND oauth_source->>'grant_id' ~ '^lmm_gr_[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND oauth_source->>'access_id' ~ '^lmm_ac_[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'scopes')='array'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'grant_id')='string'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'access_id')='string'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'client_id')='string'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'issuer')='string'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'resource')='string'
        AND (oauth_source->'scopes') ? 'models:invoke'
        AND jsonb_array_length(oauth_source->'scopes') BETWEEN 2 AND 68
        AND (oauth_source->>'expires_at') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$'
        AND (oauth_source->>'expires_at')::numeric<=253402300799
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'budget_credits')='number'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'user_id')='number'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'personal_account_id')='number'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'user_version')='number'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'consent_version')='number'
        AND jsonb_typeof(oauth_source->'expires_at')='number'
        AND (oauth_source->>'budget_credits')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991) IS TRUE)),
    oauth_family_id TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (oauth_source->>'grant_id') STORED,
    oauth_access_id TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (oauth_source->>'access_id') STORED,
    oauth_client_id TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (oauth_source->>'client_id') STORED,
    oauth_issuer TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (oauth_source->>'issuer') STORED,
    oauth_resource TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (oauth_source->>'resource') STORED,
    oauth_user_version BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((oauth_source->>'user_version')::bigint) STORED,
    oauth_consent_version BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((oauth_source->>'consent_version')::bigint) STORED,
    oauth_budget_credits BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((oauth_source->>'budget_credits')::bigint) STORED,
    oauth_purpose TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN oauth_source IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'normal_model'::text END) STORED,
    owner_account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    payer_account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    fingerprint BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(fingerprint) = 32),
    worker_digest BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(worker_digest) = 32),
    spec_digest BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(spec_digest) = 32),
    price JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(price) = 'object'),
    source_subscription_id BIGINT REFERENCES core_charging.subscriptions(id),
    source_start BIGINT,
    source_end BIGINT,
    authorized_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    lease_until BIGINT NOT NULL,
    hard_deadline BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (hard_deadline > authorized_at),
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('reserved', 'streaming', 'reconcile', 'settled', 'released')),
    reserved BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (reserved >= 0),
    input_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (input_tokens >= 0),
    cached_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cached_tokens BETWEEN 0 AND input_tokens),
    output_tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (output_tokens >= 0),
    image_usage JSONB CHECK (image_usage IS NULL OR ((
        jsonb_typeof(image_usage)='object'
        AND image_usage ?& ARRAY['output_images','provider_receipt_sha256']
        AND image_usage - ARRAY['output_images','provider_receipt_sha256']='{}'::jsonb
        AND jsonb_typeof(image_usage->'output_images')='number'
        AND (image_usage->>'output_images') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$'
        AND (image_usage->>'output_images')::integer BETWEEN 1 AND 128
        AND jsonb_typeof(image_usage->'provider_receipt_sha256')='array'
        AND jsonb_array_length(image_usage->'provider_receipt_sha256')=32
        AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(image_usage->'provider_receipt_sha256', '$[*] ? (@.type() != "number" || @ < 0 || @ > 255 || @ % 1 != 0)')
        AND jsonb_path_exists(image_usage->'provider_receipt_sha256', '$[*] ? (@ > 0)')
        AND jsonb_typeof(price->'image')='object'
        AND input_tokens=0 AND cached_tokens=0 AND output_tokens=0) IS TRUE)),
    CHECK (NOT (price ? 'image') OR (state <> 'settled' OR image_usage IS NOT NULL)),
    -- Every image quote has one durable operation source, including native keys.
    CHECK ((image_operation_id IS NOT NULL) = ((jsonb_typeof(price->'image')='object') IS TRUE)),
    CHECK (image_usage IS NULL OR image_operation_id IS NOT NULL),
    settled BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (settled BETWEEN 0 AND reserved),
    refunded BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (refunded BETWEEN 0 AND settled),
    revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0),
    outcome TEXT,
    CHECK ((key_id IS NOT NULL AND oauth_source IS NULL AND assistant_grant_id IS NULL AND assistant_sponsor_account_id IS NULL
            AND (image_operation_id IS NULL OR (image_operation_id=id AND jsonb_typeof(price->'image')='object')))
        OR (key_id IS NULL AND oauth_source IS NOT NULL AND assistant_grant_id IS NULL AND assistant_sponsor_account_id IS NULL AND image_operation_id IS NULL
            AND (oauth_source->>'user_id')::bigint=actor_user_id
            AND (oauth_source->>'personal_account_id')::bigint=owner_account_id
            AND payer_account_id=owner_account_id)
        OR (key_id IS NULL AND oauth_source IS NULL AND assistant_grant_id IS NOT NULL AND image_operation_id IS NULL
            AND ((assistant_sponsor_account_id IS NULL AND payer_account_id=owner_account_id)
              OR (assistant_sponsor_account_id IS NOT NULL AND payer_account_id=assistant_sponsor_account_id)))
        OR (key_id IS NULL AND oauth_source IS NULL AND assistant_grant_id IS NULL AND assistant_sponsor_account_id IS NULL
            AND image_operation_id IS NOT NULL AND payer_account_id=owner_account_id AND jsonb_typeof(price->'image')='object')),
    CHECK (lease_until <= hard_deadline),
    CHECK ((source_subscription_id IS NULL AND source_start IS NULL AND source_end IS NULL)
        OR (source_subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND source_start IS NOT NULL
            AND source_end IS NOT NULL AND source_end > source_start)),
    CHECK ((state = 'settled' AND outcome IS NOT NULL)
        OR (state <> 'settled' AND settled = 0 AND refunded = 0 AND outcome IS NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX requests_payer_window ON core_charging.requests(payer_account_id, authorized_at);
CREATE INDEX requests_oauth_family ON core_charging.requests(oauth_family_id,authorized_at) WHERE oauth_family_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX requests_actor_window ON core_charging.requests(actor_user_id, authorized_at);
CREATE INDEX requests_key_window ON core_charging.requests(key_id, authorized_at);
CREATE INDEX requests_entitlement ON core_charging.requests(source_subscription_id, source_start);
CREATE INDEX requests_expired ON core_charging.requests(lease_until, id)
    WHERE state IN ('reserved', 'streaming');

-- Non-model spending participates in the same caps without pretending to be a
-- model request. Only Rust's same-transaction commerce writer may add a row.
CREATE TABLE core_charging.external_consumption (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    domain TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (domain IN ('commerce','toolmarket','bounty')),
    actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    key_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
    payer_account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
    authorized_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (authorized_at BETWEEN -62135596800 AND 253402300799),
    amount_credits BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount_credits > 0),
    refunded BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (refunded BETWEEN 0 AND amount_credits)
);
CREATE INDEX external_consumption_payer ON core_charging.external_consumption(payer_account_id,authorized_at);
CREATE INDEX external_consumption_actor ON core_charging.external_consumption(actor_user_id,authorized_at);
CREATE INDEX external_consumption_key ON core_charging.external_consumption(key_id,authorized_at);

-- These are audit snapshots, not mutable counters or monetary balances.
CREATE TABLE core_charging.budget_checks (
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_charging.requests(id),
    request_revision BIGINT NOT NULL,
    budget_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_charging.budgets(id),
    budget_revision BIGINT NOT NULL,
    start_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    end_at BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (end_at > start_at),
    limit_credits BIGINT NOT NULL,
    unlimited BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    requested_credits BIGINT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (request_id, request_revision, budget_id)
);
CREATE TABLE core_charging.usage_events (
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_charging.requests(id),
    event_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(event_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    detail JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(detail) = 'object'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    PRIMARY KEY (request_id, event_id)
);
CREATE TABLE core_charging.refunds (
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_charging.requests(id),
    refund_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(refund_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    amount BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
    evidence TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(evidence) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    PRIMARY KEY (request_id, refund_id)
);
CREATE TABLE core_charging.policy_events (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    budget_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_charging.budgets(id),
    detail JSONB NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);

-- Do not attach usage to membership versions, key digests, or policy revisions.
-- A cap added after consumption sees that consumption immediately.
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.committed_credits(p_state TEXT, p_reserved BIGINT,
    p_settled BIGINT, p_refunded BIGINT) RETURNS BIGINT
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS $$
    SELECT CASE WHEN p_state IN ('reserved', 'streaming', 'reconcile') THEN p_reserved
        WHEN p_state = 'settled' THEN p_settled - p_refunded ELSE 0 END
$$;
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'charging history is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514'; END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER requests_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON core_charging.requests
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER budgets_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON core_charging.budgets
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON core_charging.subscriptions
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER budget_opening_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_charging.budget_opening_consumption
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER subscription_opening_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_charging.subscription_opening_consumption
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER budget_opening_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON core_charging.budget_opening_consumption
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER subscription_opening_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON core_charging.subscription_opening_consumption
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER external_consumption_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON core_charging.external_consumption
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER external_consumption_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON core_charging.external_consumption
    FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_external_consumption() RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog AS $$
BEGIN
    IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'refunded') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'refunded')
       OR NEW.refunded < OLD.refunded THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'external consumption identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER external_consumption_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON core_charging.external_consumption
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_external_consumption();
CREATE TRIGGER checks_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_charging.budget_checks
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER usage_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_charging.usage_events
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_charging.refunds
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE TRIGGER policies_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_charging.policy_events
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.no_delete();
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_budget() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'limit_credits' - 'unlimited' - 'display_limit_credits' - 'revision') IS DISTINCT FROM
       (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'limit_credits' - 'unlimited' - 'display_limit_credits' - 'revision') OR NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'budget identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER budget_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON core_charging.budgets
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_budget();
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_subscription() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'active') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'active') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'subscription grant is immutable' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER subscription_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON core_charging.subscriptions
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_subscription();
CREATE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_request() RETURNS TRIGGER LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
    IF (NEW.id, NEW.actor_user_id, NEW.key_id, NEW.oauth_source, NEW.assistant_grant_id, NEW.assistant_sponsor_account_id, NEW.image_operation_id, NEW.owner_account_id, NEW.payer_account_id,
        NEW.fingerprint, NEW.worker_digest, NEW.spec_digest, NEW.price, NEW.source_subscription_id,
        NEW.source_start, NEW.source_end, NEW.authorized_at, NEW.hard_deadline)
        IS DISTINCT FROM
       (OLD.id, OLD.actor_user_id, OLD.key_id, OLD.oauth_source, OLD.assistant_grant_id, OLD.assistant_sponsor_account_id, OLD.image_operation_id, OLD.owner_account_id, OLD.payer_account_id,
        OLD.fingerprint, OLD.worker_digest, OLD.spec_digest, OLD.price, OLD.source_subscription_id,
        OLD.source_start, OLD.source_end, OLD.authorized_at, OLD.hard_deadline)
       OR NEW.reserved < OLD.reserved OR NEW.refunded < OLD.refunded
       OR NEW.input_tokens < OLD.input_tokens OR NEW.cached_tokens < OLD.cached_tokens
       OR NEW.output_tokens < OLD.output_tokens OR NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1
       OR (OLD.image_usage IS NOT NULL AND NEW.image_usage IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.image_usage) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid charging mutation' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    -- Stored generated OAuth projections are NULL in NEW during BEFORE UPDATE.
    -- Their immutable source is checked above; compare every remaining mutable
    -- business column explicitly so a legitimate terminal refund stays possible.
    IF OLD.state IN ('settled', 'released') AND
        (NEW.state, NEW.reserved, NEW.lease_until, NEW.input_tokens, NEW.cached_tokens,
         NEW.output_tokens, NEW.image_usage, NEW.settled, NEW.outcome) IS DISTINCT FROM
        (OLD.state, OLD.reserved, OLD.lease_until, OLD.input_tokens, OLD.cached_tokens,
         OLD.output_tokens, OLD.image_usage, OLD.settled, OLD.outcome) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'request is terminal' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.state <> OLD.state AND NOT
       ((OLD.state = 'reserved' AND NEW.state IN ('streaming', 'released'))
        OR (OLD.state = 'streaming' AND NEW.state IN ('settled', 'reconcile'))
        OR (OLD.state = 'reconcile' AND NEW.state = 'settled')) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid charging transition' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER request_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON core_charging.requests
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_request();

-- Fresh database component. Final integration must install this explicitly.
-- No automatic migration, core balance access, or dependency on a live Go host.
CREATE SCHEMA core_events;
CREATE TABLE core_events.capacity (
    singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (singleton),
    max_events bigint NOT NULL CHECK (max_events > 0),
    max_bytes bigint NOT NULL CHECK (max_bytes > 0),
    pending_events bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pending_events BETWEEN 0 AND max_events),
    pending_bytes bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pending_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND max_bytes)
);
INSERT INTO core_events.capacity(singleton,max_events,max_bytes) VALUES (true,100000,268435456);
CREATE TABLE core_events.subscriptions (
    consumer_id text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(consumer_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    service_id text NOT NULL CHECK (length(service_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    event_types text[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(event_types) BETWEEN 1 AND 32),
    max_pending bigint NOT NULL CHECK (max_pending > 0),
    pending bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pending BETWEEN 0 AND max_pending)
);
CREATE TABLE core_events.outbox (
    id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id > 0),
    event_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(event_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    event_type text NOT NULL CHECK (length(event_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 96),
    schema_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version > 0),
    resource_id bigint NOT NULL CHECK (resource_id > 0),
    resource_version bigint NOT NULL CHECK (resource_version >= 0),
    payload bytea CHECK (octet_length(payload) <= 16384),
    content_sha256 bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(content_sha256) = 32),
    pending_deliveries bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pending_deliveries >= 0),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    CHECK (payload IS NOT NULL OR pending_deliveries = 0)
);
CREATE INDEX outbox_retained_type ON core_events.outbox(event_type,id) WHERE payload IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TABLE core_events.deliveries (
    consumer_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES core_events.subscriptions(consumer_id),
    event_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_events.outbox(id),
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
    available_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    lease_digest bytea CHECK (octet_length(lease_digest) = 32),
    lease_until timestamptz,
    acknowledged_at timestamptz,
    retry_reason smallint CHECK (retry_reason BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    PRIMARY KEY (consumer_id,event_id),
    CHECK (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_digest IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (acknowledged_at IS NULL OR lease_digest IS NOT NULL)
);
CREATE INDEX deliveries_ready ON core_events.deliveries(consumer_id,available_at,event_id)
    WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL;
-- Both event tombstones and acknowledgement receipts are retained. Deleting
-- these reopens the replay window. Capacity bounds UNACKNOWLEDGED payloads.
CREATE TABLE core_events.inbox (
    service_id text NOT NULL CHECK (length(service_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
    actor_id bigint NOT NULL CHECK (actor_id > 0),
    method text NOT NULL CHECK (length(method) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    idempotency_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 16 AND 128),
    request_sha256 bytea NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_sha256) = 32),
    response bytea CHECK (octet_length(response) <= 16384),
    completed_at timestamptz,
    PRIMARY KEY(service_id,actor_id,method,idempotency_key),
    CHECK ((response IS NULL) = (completed_at IS NULL))
);
CREATE FUNCTION core_events.require_complete_inbox() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = pg_catalog,core_events AS $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core_events.inbox WHERE service_id=NEW.service_id
        AND actor_id=NEW.actor_id AND method=NEW.method
        AND idempotency_key=NEW.idempotency_key AND response IS NULL) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'command inbox must complete in its business transaction'
            USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$$;
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER inbox_complete_at_commit
    AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON core_events.inbox DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_events.require_complete_inbox();

-- Explicit fresh-install component. Startup never installs or upgrades it.
CREATE SCHEMA core_abuse;
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.settings (
    singleton BOOLEAN PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (singleton),
    revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0),
    document JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"version":1,"policies":[]}'::jsonb
        CHECK (jsonb_typeof(document)='object' AND octet_length(document::text)<=131072)
);
INSERT INTO core_abuse.settings(singleton) VALUES (TRUE);
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.user_marks (
    user_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    marked BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    policy_id TEXT,
    revision BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
    CHECK ((marked AND policy_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT marked AND policy_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK (policy_id IS NULL OR length(policy_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64)
);
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.previews (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id)=64),
    actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    operation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(operation_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 128),
    request_digest BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_digest)=32),
    preview_hash BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(preview_hash)=32),
    snapshot JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(snapshot)='object'),
    response JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(response)='object'),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(actor_user_id,operation_id)
);
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.operations (
    actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    operation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(operation_id) BETWEEN 8 AND 128),
    request_digest BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(request_digest)=32),
    result JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(result)='object'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    PRIMARY KEY(actor_user_id,operation_id)
);
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.audit (
    id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('policies','users')),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
    detail JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(detail)='object'),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
    FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id,operation_id)
        REFERENCES core_abuse.operations(actor_user_id,operation_id),
    UNIQUE(actor_user_id,operation_id)
);
-- Ephemeral resource controls, never wallets, reservations or model charges.
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.model_counters (
    subject_id BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_id >= 0),
    minute BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (minute > 0),
    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 100001),
    PRIMARY KEY(subject_id,minute)
);
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.model_leases (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id)=64),
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
    credential_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    finished_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE(credential_id,request_id)
);
CREATE INDEX abuse_live_leases ON core_abuse.model_leases(expires_at,user_id)
    WHERE finished_at IS NULL;

-- Private evidence captured in the successful account-creation transaction.
-- Historical accounts must not be backfilled from log guesses or sessions.
CREATE TABLE core_abuse.registration_observations (
 user_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
 registered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 username_at_registration TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(username_at_registration) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
 email_at_registration TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(email_at_registration)<=320),
 source_ip INET,
 source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('unknown','socket','trusted_x_forwarded_for')),
 source_policy_version INTEGER,
 CHECK ((source_kind='unknown' AND source_ip IS NULL AND source_policy_version IS NULL)
  OR (source_kind<>'unknown' AND source_ip IS NOT NULL AND source_policy_version=1)),
 CHECK (source_ip IS NULL OR masklen(source_ip)=CASE family(source_ip) WHEN 4 THEN 32 ELSE 128 END)
);
CREATE INDEX registration_observations_time ON core_abuse.registration_observations(registered_at,user_id);
CREATE INDEX registration_observations_ip ON core_abuse.registration_observations(source_ip,registered_at,user_id)
 WHERE source_ip IS NOT NULL;

-- Immutable historical source receipts and logs, installed by fresh init-db.
-- Import is offline owner work; ordinary startup and runtime never write here.
CREATE SCHEMA core_history;
CREATE TABLE core_history.sources (
  source_id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  contract_version text NOT NULL CHECK(contract_version='core.history-source.v1'),
  source_archive_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_archive_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  mapping_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(mapping_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  source_namespace text NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_namespace) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  observed_at bigint NOT NULL CHECK(observed_at>0),
  complete boolean NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(source_archive_sha256,mapping_sha256,source_namespace)
);
CREATE TABLE core_history.log_records (
  source_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_history.sources(source_id),
  source_log_id bigint NOT NULL CHECK(source_log_id BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
  canonical_event_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(canonical_event_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 256),
  source_row_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_row_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
  owner_account_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
  token_id bigint REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
  created_at bigint NOT NULL CHECK(created_at BETWEEN 0 AND 253402300799),
  log_type smallint NOT NULL CHECK(log_type BETWEEN 0 AND 7),
  quota bigint,
  pricing_credits_per_usd bigint CHECK(pricing_credits_per_usd BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991),
  prompt_tokens bigint,
  completion_tokens bigint,
  username text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(octet_length(username)<=256),
  token_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(octet_length(token_name)<=256),
  model_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(octet_length(model_name)<=256),
  channel_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(channel_id>=0),
  group_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(octet_length(group_name)<=256),
  request_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(octet_length(request_id)<=256),
  upstream_request_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(octet_length(upstream_request_id)<=256),
  PRIMARY KEY(source_id,source_log_id)
);
CREATE INDEX history_user_time ON core_history.log_records(user_id,owner_account_id,created_at DESC,source_id DESC,source_log_id DESC);
CREATE INDEX history_token_time ON core_history.log_records(token_id,created_at DESC,source_id DESC,source_log_id DESC);
CREATE INDEX history_time ON core_history.log_records(created_at DESC,source_id DESC,source_log_id DESC);
-- Offline reviewed coverage includes mapped entities with no historical rows.
-- NULL token_id is user/account coverage; key reads additionally require their
-- exact credential mapping. Runtime receives SELECT only, never INSERT rights.
CREATE TABLE core_history.scope_receipts (
  source_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_history.sources(source_id),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
  owner_account_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
  token_id bigint REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
  source_archive_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_archive_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  mapping_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(mapping_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  source_scope_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_scope_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  complete boolean NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(source_id,user_id,owner_account_id,token_id)
);
CREATE INDEX history_scope_lookup ON core_history.scope_receipts(user_id,owner_account_id,token_id,source_id);
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA core_history FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA core_history FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA core_history FROM PUBLIC;

-- Fresh installation after native identity and Core assistant. No startup DDL.
CREATE SCHEMA core_assistant_tools;
CREATE TABLE core_assistant_tools.confirmations (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(operation_id ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 turn_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(turn_id ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
 actor_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.users(id),
 account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.accounts(id),
 credential_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.credentials(id),
 auth_version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(auth_version>0),
 web_session_sid TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES core_identity.web_sessions(sid),
 tool_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tool_name IN ('set_overview_greeting','create_site_issue','update_site_issue','request_human_support','prepare_admin_site_policy_change')),
 tool_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 arguments_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(arguments_sha256)=32),
 draft_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(draft_sha256)=32),
 preview JSONB NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(preview)='object' AND octet_length(preview::text)<=16384),
 resource_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 resource_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
 nonce_sha256 BYTEA CHECK(nonce_sha256 IS NULL OR octet_length(nonce_sha256)=32),
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','approved','rejected')),
 confirmed_at BIGINT,
 CHECK((state='pending')=(confirmed_at IS NULL))
);
CREATE FUNCTION core_assistant_tools.guard_confirmation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.state<>'pending' OR
  (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['nonce_sha256','state','confirmed_at']) IS DISTINCT FROM
  (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['nonce_sha256','state','confirmed_at']) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable assistant confirmation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER assistant_confirmation_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_assistant_tools.confirmations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_assistant_tools.guard_confirmation();
CREATE TRIGGER assistant_confirmation_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON core_assistant_tools.confirmations FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA core_assistant_tools FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA core_assistant_tools FROM PUBLIC;

installer_metadata.sql: CREATE TABLE core_meta.component_contract (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fingerprint BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(fingerprint)=32)); CREATE TABLE core_meta.runtime_contract (singleton BOOLEAN PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT TRUE CHECK (singleton), catalog_fingerprint BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK (octet_length(catalog_fingerprint)=32));

-- Code schema upgrades are independent from historical source-import receipts.
-- The same bytes run on a fresh installation and on the explicit 24->25 path.
CREATE TABLE core_meta.schema_upgrades (
    upgrade_id TEXT CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_pkey PRIMARY KEY,
    procedure TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_procedure_check
        CHECK (procedure = 'core-24-to-25-trust-pricing-v1'),
    request_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_request_check
        CHECK (octet_length(request_sha256) = 32),
    predecessor_manifest_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_pre_manifest_check
        CHECK (octet_length(predecessor_manifest_sha256) = 32),
    predecessor_catalog_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_pre_catalog_check
        CHECK (octet_length(predecessor_catalog_sha256) = 32),
    successor_manifest_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_post_manifest_check
        CHECK (octet_length(successor_manifest_sha256) = 32),
    successor_catalog_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_post_catalog_check
        CHECK (octet_length(successor_catalog_sha256) = 32),
    -- Exact PG18 CATALOG entries; SQL source hashes are not deparser hashes.
    -- Only the two reviewed image constraint/function changes are allowed.
    image_definition_changes JSONB NOT NULL CONSTRAINT schema_upgrades_image_changes_check
        CHECK (jsonb_typeof(image_definition_changes) = 'array'
            AND jsonb_array_length(image_definition_changes) = 2),
    database_system_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,
    database_oid OID NOT NULL,
    database_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    installer_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    runtime_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    extensions_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    -- This is when the row was constructed, not a claim of a known COMMIT time.
    recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);
REVOKE ALL ON core_meta.schema_upgrades FROM PUBLIC;

-- Owner-only receipts for compiled, explicitly supported additive upgrades.
-- This metadata is identical on a fresh installation and an explicit upgrade.
CREATE TABLE core_meta.component_upgrades (
 upgrade_id TEXT CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_pkey PRIMARY KEY,
 procedure TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_procedure_check
   CHECK(procedure='core-additive-components-v1'),
 request_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_request_check CHECK(octet_length(request_sha256)=32),
 predecessor_manifest_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_pre_manifest_check CHECK(octet_length(predecessor_manifest_sha256)=32),
 predecessor_catalog_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_pre_catalog_check CHECK(octet_length(predecessor_catalog_sha256)=32),
 successor_manifest_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_post_manifest_check CHECK(octet_length(successor_manifest_sha256)=32),
 successor_catalog_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_post_catalog_check CHECK(octet_length(successor_catalog_sha256)=32),
 predecessor_components INTEGER NOT NULL,
 successor_components INTEGER NOT NULL,
 delta_components JSONB NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_delta_check
   CHECK(jsonb_typeof(delta_components)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(delta_components) BETWEEN 1 AND 16),
 added_catalog_entries JSONB NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_catalog_check
   CHECK(jsonb_typeof(added_catalog_entries)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(added_catalog_entries)>0),
 preserved_data_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_data_check CHECK(octet_length(preserved_data_sha256)=32),
 preserved_permissions_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_permissions_check CHECK(octet_length(preserved_permissions_sha256)=32),
 database_system_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,
 database_oid OID NOT NULL,
 database_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 installer_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 runtime_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 extensions_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(),
 CONSTRAINT component_upgrades_counts_check CHECK(predecessor_components>=25 AND successor_components>predecessor_components)
);
REVOKE ALL ON core_meta.component_upgrades FROM PUBLIC;

-- Exact owner-only Core26 ledger revision. Independent of financial imports.
CREATE TABLE core_meta.ledger_revisions (
 upgrade_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 procedure TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(procedure='core-26-ledger-escrow-submit-v1'),
 request_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(request_sha256)=32),
 predecessor_manifest_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(predecessor_manifest_sha256)=32),
 predecessor_catalog_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(predecessor_catalog_sha256)=32),
 successor_manifest_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(successor_manifest_sha256)=32),
 successor_catalog_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(successor_catalog_sha256)=32),
 removed_catalog_entries JSONB NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(removed_catalog_entries)='array'),
 added_catalog_entries JSONB NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(added_catalog_entries)='array'),
 preserved_data_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(preserved_data_sha256)=32),
 preserved_permissions_sha256 BYTEA NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(preserved_permissions_sha256)=32),
 database_system_identifier TEXT NOT NULL,
 database_oid OID NOT NULL,
 database_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 installer_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 runtime_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 extensions_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp()
);
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_revisions_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON core_meta.ledger_revisions
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_revisions_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON core_meta.ledger_revisions
 FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION core_billing.ledger_immutable();
REVOKE ALL ON core_meta.ledger_revisions FROM PUBLIC;

oauth_catalog_sql:
WITH catalog_path AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT pg_catalog.set_config('search_path','pg_catalog',true)
), oauth_namespace AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT n.oid FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN catalog_path WHERE n.nspname='core_oauth'
), definitions AS (
 SELECT json_build_array('relation',c.relname,c.relkind)::text AS d
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('column',c.relname,a.attnum,a.attname,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull,a.attidentity,a.attgenerated,pg_get_expr(ad.adbin,ad.adrelid))::text
 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef ad ON ad.adrelid=a.attrelid AND ad.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace) AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('constraint',k.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true))::text FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=k.connamespace WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('index',c.relname,pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid))::text FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace)
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('function',p.proname,pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))::text FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace) AND p.prokind IN ('f','p')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('trigger',c.relname,t.tgname,t.tgenabled,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true))::text FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace) AND NOT t.tgisinternal
 UNION ALL
 SELECT json_build_array('internal-trigger',c.relname,k.conname,pn.nspname,p.proname,t.tgtype,t.tgenabled,t.tgdeferrable,t.tginitdeferred,t.tgattr::text,encode(t.tgargs,'hex'),pg_get_expr(t.tgqual,t.tgrelid))::text FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace LEFT JOIN pg_constraint k ON k.oid=t.tgconstraint WHERE n.oid IN (SELECT oid FROM oauth_namespace) AND t.tgisinternal
) SELECT d FROM definitions ORDER BY d COLLATE "C"
